Summarize the following text in exactly one sentence: 'The Amazon rainforest spans roughly 5.5 million square kilometers across nine South American countries. It produces about 20% of the world's oxygen, is home to an estimated 10% of all known species on Earth, and plays a critical role in regulating global and regional rainfall patterns. Deforestation for cattle ranching and agriculture has removed close to 17% of the original forest cover since 1970, prompting international conservation efforts.'

expected: The Amazon rainforest is a vast, biodiverse South American ecosystem critical to global oxygen production and rainfall regulation, but has lost about 17% of its cover to deforestation since 1970.
judge_rubric: PASS if the response is a single sentence (or close to it -- minor punctuation-driven splits are fine) that accurately captures at least three of: the forest's size/location, its share of world oxygen production, its biodiversity, and the ~17% deforestation since 1970 figure. FAIL if it omits the deforestation statistic entirely, invents a different statistic, or is more than roughly two sentences long.
